comment: restore.c:restgamestate -> role.c:role_init() on restore. A debug Wizard's nemesis, the Dark One, has no M2_MALE/M2_FEMALE/M2_NEUTER flag, so role_init() draws rn2(100) for svq.quest_status.nemgend on every restore (role.c:2059). The first segment creates the Dark One next to the hero and saves; the second restores, declines to keep the save file, and waits two turns so monmove.c:dochug -> quest.c:quest_stat_check runs for the nemesis. Seeds and datetimes were chosen independently of every recorded session.
